title-group.article-title: Invented allele comparisons at two linked erythroid variants

abstract.p: We compared the alleles of two invented linked variants, rs1427407 and rs90000017, in erythroid cells.

sec.title: GATA1 binding at rs1427407
sec.p: The T allele probe bound GATA1 more strongly than the G allele probe in K562 nuclear extract.

sec.title: Binding at the linked variant
sec.p: At rs90000017, the A allele probe bound GATA1 more strongly than the C allele probe in K562 nuclear extract.
Probes for rs1427407 and rs90000017 were compared side by side, and the T allele probe bound TAL1 more strongly than the G allele probe.
The control variant rs14274070 was tested in the same extracts, and its T and G probes showed no difference in GATA1 binding.

sec.title: Reporter assays
sec.p: The variant at chr2:60,490,908 (T/G) lies in the enhancer, and its T allele construct gave 2-fold higher luciferase activity than the G allele construct in K562 cells.

sec.title: Online methods
sec.p: The variant was genotyped as rs1427407 (chr2:60,490,908 T>G) in every line; the linked variant was genotyped separately.
